gpu_tip: ~18GB total at 128K context, and the rung bartowski recommends as the general-purpose default. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RX 7800 XT) plus DDR5 system RAM covers it with only a little layer offloading; the KV cache knob's q4_0 option fits it on the GPU entirely.
mac_tip: Needs ~18GB — fits a 24GB MacBook Pro (M4, M4 Pro, M5, or M5 Pro) comfortably.
